_readme: Short blurbs shown in the builder. Edit the text inside the quotes. New Kanka entries get a starter blurb from their first sentence; rewrite it whenever you like. The automation never changes a blurb once it is here.

9817574.name: Bullywugs
9817574.blurb: Medium toadfolk with a penchant for cronyism and arcane spellcasting.

9823039.name: Grippli
9823039.blurb: Small druidic frogfolk of Kara-Tur's southern marshes.

9504618.name: Grung
9504618.blurb: Small poison-dart frogfolk of the Chultan treetops, whose ambitious, self-serving society still practices slavery.

9840616.name: Mandrakes
9840616.blurb: Short, root-bodied plantfolk - originally awakened mandrake plants. Stubborn, quick to anger, and a shrill voice that can literally kill.

9840646.name: Myconids
9840646.blurb: Mushroomfolk from small Underdark clans. Each individual an intelligent mycelial network grown through a host - usually a corpse.

9840613.name: Treants
9840613.blurb: Towering awakened trees found in old-growth forests and areas of Fey influence. Patient and practically immovable.

9880379.name: Aranea
9880379.blurb: Arachnidfolk shapeshifters from Calimshan. Resemeble feminine humans in one form and massive spiders in the other.

9916485.name: Chitine
9916485.blurb: Horrific Arachnidfolk whose blood was created by blending that of the Drow and common Wolf Spider. Humanoid torsos with arachnid heads, an extra pair of upper limbs, and body-wide urticating hairs. Live in the Underdark in clans.

9875256.name: Driders
9875256.blurb: Drow cursed by the goddess Lolth. Twisted humanoid upper halves with arachnid thoraxes and lower limbs. Loners from the Underdark.

9916393.name: Rastipede
9916393.blurb: Antfolk with centipede lower halves. Spacefarers from somewhere far beyond Realmspace. Chatty yet efficient merchants on Spelljamming waystations.

9839590.name: Thri-Kreen
9839590.blurb: Six-limbed mantisfolk from colonies in Southern Faerun. Adept psions and warriors.

9839601.name: Autognome
9839601.blurb: Constructs near-identical to their Rock Gnome inventors. Tireless and enthusiastically work-driven. Constant tinkerers.

9854203.name: Flesh Golem
9854203.blurb: Flesh-stitched frankensteins containing the spirits of elementals.

9848481.name: Gargoyle
9848481.blurb: Stoney earth elementals who serve evil mortals on Toril or Devils in the outer planes.

9821465.name: Nimblewright
9821465.blurb: Arcane-mechanical servants abandoned when Netheril fell over two thousand years ago. Still occasionally uncovered from the sands of Anauroch.

9821407.name: Warforged
9821407.blurb: Living constructs from the world of Eberron, rare on Toril and usually found crewing Spelljammers.

9460685.name: Aarakocra
9460685.blurb: Winged birdfolk made by the Aearee, now spread across Toril, with many returning to their ancestral Isle of Aearee.

9840625.name: Harpies
9840625.blurb: Winged Aviane with a feminine human torso, taloned feathered legs, and catlike yellow eyes. Alluring voice and a proclivity for enchantment spells.

9504616.name: Kenku
9504616.blurb: Flightless crowfolk who live in mixed population cities, especially southern Faerun and the Isle of Aearee. Capable of exceptional mimickry.

9461770.name: Centaur
9461770.blurb: Fey with Elven upper halves and equine lower halves. Live in small warbands in the forests of Central Faerun.

9497316.name: Changeling
9497316.blurb: Fey who reshape their faces and bodies at will through a true biological change, beneath a pale, white-eyed true face.

9461768.name: Darklings
9461768.blurb: Grey-skinned Fey with Elven torsos and crow-like feet. Severe sunlight sensivitiy. Mummy-like wrappings part of everyday fashion.

9461774.name: Dryads
9461774.blurb: A variety of Fey with special ties to natural landmarks. Resemble the natural topography of their lineage.

9461058.name: Eladrin
9461058.blurb: Elves who mutated over thousands of years in the Feywild. Mercurial creatures whose emotions change their literal form.

9461765.name: Elves
9461765.blurb: Pointed-eared creations of the god Corellon. Wide variety of subspecies with different cultures. Paved the way for other mortals in Faerun, a fact they can be haughty about.

9461766.name: Faeries
9461766.blurb: Small and tiny Fey such as Pixies, Sprites, Korreds and Brownies. Embrace the chaotic 'laws' of the Feywild.

9926466.name: Gloura
9926466.blurb: Silver-skinned Unseelie Fey with black insect eyes and moth wings. Live in solitude in the Underdark.

9461771.name: Gnomes
9461771.blurb: Small, inventive humanoids descended from Fey. Gond's favored species, came up with some of Toril's most-used modern inventions.

9606600.name: Goblins
9606600.blurb: Diminuitive Fey with green skin and sharp ears. Small, vicious, and cunning folk who roam the Underdark in clans.

9531279.name: Hobgoblins
9531279.blurb: Medium Fey who march under their god Maglubiyet's iron banner. Warlike, efficient, and disciplined folk who dominate other goblinkin.

9706299.name: Bugbears
9706299.blurb: Hulking furry Fey with lanky, cat-like grace. Expert hiders and kidnappers. Love good naps and easy loot.

9461769.name: Hagkin
9461769.blurb: Fey Descendents of Hags. Minor hag-like powers. Love elaborate rituals and esoterica

9497467.name: Harengon
9497467.blurb: Rabbitfolk of the Feywild with powerful legs, keen ears, and a wanderlust that sends them all over Toril.

9461772.name: Hengeyokai
9461772.blurb: Fey beastfolk from Kara-Tur with dozens of subspecies. Held in legend as tricksters who stalk and prank humans.

9478533.name: Orcs
9478533.blurb: Warlike humanoid cousins to the Elves. Stooped, muscular frames, with green or gray skin. Internal bloodlust for revenge fuel by their ancestor-god Gruumsh.

9461767.name: Satyr
9461767.blurb: Masculine Fey with Elvish torsoes and goat-like legs. Live in integrated cities or on Feywild reservations.

9820404.name: Geleton
9820404.blurb: The lifeforce of an ooze fused to a skeleton, effectively creating a humanoid. Result of necromantic magic gone awry.

9821579.name: Oozekin
9821579.blurb: Sapient supercolonies of bacteria with innate curiosity for the world.

9820395.name: Plasmoids
9820395.blurb: Translucent spacefaring Oozes who do well aboard spelljammers. Have a visible 'brain' near the top of their membrane apparatus. Not native to Toril.

9605363.name: Firbolgs
9605363.blurb: Reclusive, fur-covered giants about 10 feet tall. Live in secluded druidic societies and keep ancient giant traditions.

9692738.name: Fomorians
9692738.blurb: Disfigured, hunched giants of the Underdark and Feydark. Unsettling to behold but exceptional in a fight.

9718008.name: Trolls
9718008.blurb: Regenerative giants from North Faerun. Live in scattered herds that prey on humans and dwarves.

9690523.name: Verbeeg
9690523.blurb: Brutish giants with exaggerated facial features. Lacking in empathy but make excellent pit bosses and bodyguards.

9461066.name: Dwarves
9461066.blurb: Stocky, typically bearded Homo who prefer life underground or in the mountains, with each subspecies attuned to the land it calls home.

9839931.name: Giffs
9839931.blurb: Hippo-like mammals alien to Toril. Absolute units covered in tribal tattoos who absolutely adore firearms.

9505161.name: Goliaths
9505161.blurb: Towering hominids of the Thesk mountains carrying a sliver of giant blood from the Giants who once took them as mates.

9838070.name: Hadozee
9838070.blurb: Chimpfolk spacefarers with winged underarms. Most often found climbing the decks of adventurer or trader spelljammers.

9466365.name: Halflings
9466365.blurb: Small, cheerful humanoids who split from Humans 1.2 million years ago in the jungles near Halruaa. Known for close-knit communities and a love of a good meal.

9461514.name: Humans
9461514.blurb: Bipedal Homo native to Toril and most other material planes. Widespread, tenacious, and short-lived, with no two quite alike.

9494884.name: Merfolk
9494884.blurb: Homo who took to the water around 2.6 million years ago and now live within the Sea of Fallen Stars. Also called Merpeople, Mermen and Mermaids.

9573593.name: Tabaxi
9573593.blurb: Catfolk from the jungles of Katashka. Agile, quickwitted, and fun-loving. Small immigrant communities in Faerûn and Kara-Tur.

9465009.name: Dayie
9465009.blurb: Sapient undead left by the aftermath of Thay's destruction. Grim, patient, and carrying a somewhat intolerable stench.

9697873.name: Dhampir
9697873.blurb: Humanoid descendents of Vampire Spawn. Pale and fanged, but able to walk in sunlight and resist parts of Vampirism's curse.

9697812.name: Shifters
9697812.blurb: Individuals who were bitten by a Werecreature but developed resistance to lycanthropy (or their offspring). Look like humanoids with beast-like features.

9782760.name: Kuo-toa
9782760.blurb: Abberrant fishfolk with the ability to project their mortal belief into immediate divine powers.

9821550.name: Locathah
9821550.blurb: Humanoid fishfolk that evolved in the Sea of Swords. Generally peaceloving, enjoy aquatic horticulture and trade.

9489661.name: Sahuagin
9489661.blurb: Planetouched sharkfolk who dominate nearly every ocean on Toril. Driven by a relentless hunger to kill, colonize, and devour. Able to detect and frenzy upon creatures who are bleeding.

9465245.name: Aasimar
9465245.blurb: Planetouched humans descended from a celestial ancestor. Tend to have glowing-skin, flame-like eyes, or spectral halos and wings.

9875231.name: Deep Imaskari
9875231.blurb: Humans changed by the depths of the Underdark. Unlike Skulks, they carried their own artificial light into the dark rather than blending with it.

9571169.name: Genasi
9571169.blurb: Planetouched humans descended from an elemental ancestor, usually a Genie. They appear human but with skin and hair reflecting the element of their heritage.

9465420.name: Gith
9465420.blurb: Planetouched humans descended from hominids enslaved by the Mind Flayers thousands of years ago. Light-green skin, jagged ears, and cat-like eyes.

9697921.name: Gnolls
9697921.blurb: Planetouched beasts created by the demon lord Yeenoghu. Tall, hunched builds resembling anthropomorphic hyenas. Easily whipped into a frenzy, unleashing their demonic rage.

9840642.name: Medusas
9840642.blurb: Serpent-tailed, snake-haired monstrosities of fiendish origin. Innate magic that turns flesh to stone.

9838042.name: Minotaur
9838042.blurb: Large bull-headed monsters created by the demon lord Baphomet. Love mazes and goring with their horns.

9693594.name: Skulks
9693594.blurb: Humans forced to evolve in the Underdark after Drow enslaved them 18,000 years ago. Hairless and slate-skinned, with a faint blue glow in their eyes.

9926529.name: Spirit Folk
9926529.blurb: Humans descended from Dryads, marked by their otherworldly beauty and treasured tattoos.

9465423.name: Tieflings
9465423.blurb: Humans descended from fiends. Humanoid appearance with mutations dependent on their exact origin (whether demonic, cthonic, or infernal).

9465744.name: Dragonborn
9465744.blurb: Militant draconic humanoids originally from Abeir. Fond of military tradition, camaraderie, with a cautious attitude towards magic.

9465492.name: Kobolds
9465492.blurb: Small, cold-blooded reptilians originally created by the Dragons. About three feet tall with shrill, barking voices.

9504621.name: Lizardfolk
9504621.blurb: Reptiles forcibly evolved by the Sarrukh. Reside in small clans withinin bogs, marshes, and savannahs. Not particularly clever, but good martial combatants and survivalists.

9505242.name: Pterafolk
9505242.blurb: The last surviving Dinosaurids. Tall creatures with massive wingspans that live in the mountain ranges of Chult.

9820447.name: Tortles
9820447.blurb: Tortoisefolk that stand four to five feet tall, bound inside armor-like shells. Small population on Toril that dwell in southern Chult.

9504619.name: Yuan-Ti
9504619.blurb: Hybridized humans and pitvipers. Poison-loving and obsessed with genetic manipulation.

10098764.name: Criminal
10098764.blurb: You eked out a living in dark alleyways, cutting purses or burgling shops.

10098785.name: Entertainer
10098785.blurb: You spent much of your youth following roving fairs and carnivals, performing odd jobs for musicians and acrobats in exchange for lessons.

10098782.name: Farmer
10098782.blurb: You grew up close to the land.

9494831.name: Akadi
9494831.blurb: Akadi is the Primordial of elemental air and other invisible, breathable gases.

9901010.name: Amauntor
9901010.blurb: Amauntor was originally a Netherese god who marked the slow, consistent march of time via the rising and setting of the sun.

9508823.name: Annam All-Father
9508823.blurb: Annam All-Father is the progenitor deity for all Giants and Gigantas.

9491971.name: AO
9491971.blurb: AO is a mysterious, featureless entity, thought to be responsible for orchestrating the Gods and their aspects.

9465747.name: Asgorath
9465747.blurb: Asgorath, known more frequently as IO to the Reptilia, is the Overdeity of Dragons.

9709630.name: Asmodeus
9709630.blurb: Asmodeus is the True Spirit deity of ambition.

9531280.name: Auril
9531280.blurb: Auril is the neutral evil goddess of cruelty.

9834621.name: Azuth
9834621.blurb: Azuth is the god of Arcane Spellcasting, Wizardry, and Sorcery.

9462516.name: Baba Yaga
9462516.blurb: The Baba Yaga ("Grandmother Hag" in Sylvan) is the patron goddess of hags.

9771534.name: Bahamut
9771534.blurb: Bahamut is the lawful good deity of Metallic True Dragons and goodly dragonkin.

9490192.name: Bane
9490192.blurb: Bane is the True Spirit of control (or will exerted upon others).

9834598.name: Beshaba
9834598.blurb: Beshaba is the Faerunian goddess and true spirit of bad luck, misfortune, and random mishap.

9495260.name: Bhaal
9495260.blurb: Bhaal is the Neutral Evil god of murder and ritual sacrifice.

9501057.name: Celestian
9501057.blurb: Celestian is the True Spirit of Departure.

9573592.name: Chauntea
9573592.blurb: Chauntea, also referred to as Mother Toril, is the true spirit of organic life, its growth and cultivation, and the enjoyment of its bounty.

9461349.name: Corellon Larethian
9461349.blurb: Corellon Larethian was the Elven aspect of Oghma, god of art, music, and beauty, leader of the Seladrine, and patron god to Elves and some Fey.

9490643.name: Cyric
9490643.blurb: Cyric is the god of betrayal.

9494833.name: Deep Sashelas
9494833.blurb: Deep Sashelas was the Elven god of Oceanic beauty.

9504932.name: Dendar
9504932.blurb: Dendar, also called Nidhogg, is an Elder Evil who elicits and consumes hopes and dreams and transforms them into nightmares.

9508555.name: Dumathoin
9508555.blurb: Dumathoin is the Dwarven god of hidden (particularly buried) secrets as well as deep earth and death.

9895730.name: Eilistraee
9895730.blurb: Eilistraee is the chaotic good Drow goddess of freedom, dance, and zest for life.

9762465.name: Eldath
9762465.blurb: Eldath is the true spirit of safety, peace, and pacifism.

9762467.name: Garagos
9762467.blurb: Garagos is the god of frenzied rage in the heat of battle.

9752615.name: Gargauth
9752615.blurb: Gargauth, also known as The Man in the Shadows, or The Puppet master, is the Archdevil of Avernus and the Lawful Evil deity of corruption through power and organizational morality.

9465749.name: Garl Glittergold
9465749.blurb: Garl Glittergold is the Chaotic Good Gnomish aspect of Tymora and god of luck with their pantheon.

9791805.name: Ghaunadaur
9791805.blurb: Ghaunadaur is the chaotic evil entity representing that which crawls or lies low to the ground.

9465428.name: Gilgeam
9465428.blurb: Gilgeam is the Lawful Evil Human, Untheric son of Bane and Tempus.

9466323.name: Gond
9466323.blurb: Gond is a prominent deity in the Faerunian Pantheon.

9494841.name: Grumbar
9494841.blurb: Grumbar is the Primordials elemental lord of earth (meaning solid matter such as rocks, dirt, and other inorganic material).

9490396.name: Gruumsh
9490396.blurb: Gruumsh is the True Spirit god of Revenge and patron god to the Orcs.

9834498.name: Helm
9834498.blurb: Helm is the true spirit of Vigilance, and he is among the Goodly Gods of the Faerunian Pantheon.

9500922.name: Hoar
9500922.blurb: Hoar is the god of poetic justice.

9701561.name: Ibrandul
9701561.blurb: Ibrandul is the god of sanctuary within darkness.

9834533.name: Ilmater
9834533.blurb: Ilmater is the god of Altruism, self-sacrifice, and perseverance in the face of suffering.

9495347.name: Istishia
9495347.blurb: Istishia is the Primordials elemental lord of elemental water.

9831373.name: Jergal
9831373.blurb: Jergal, known to Chessentans as Charon, is the God of Remembrance and member of The Dead Three.

9690475.name: Kavaki
9690475.blurb: Kavaki is the Goliath god of competition, physical fitness, and boastful tales.

9614447.name: Kelemvor
9614447.blurb: Kelemvor is the true deity of death, and he is the leader of The Dead Three.

9680642.name: Kossuth
9680642.blurb: Kossuth, the Firelord, is the elemental primordial of fire.

9465750.name: Kurtulmak
9465750.blurb: Kurtulmak is the Kobold god of lies, trickery, and trapmaking.

9714107.name: Labelas Enorath
9714107.blurb: Labelas was the Seladrine god of longevity, patience, and endurance.

9831007.name: Lanaxis
9831007.blurb: Lanaxis is the son of Othea and Annam All-Father.

9715286.name: Lathander
9715286.blurb: Lathander "The Morning Lord" is the true spirit of mortal potential and development.

9494842.name: Leira
9494842.blurb: Leira is the True Spirit God of Lies.

9777552.name: Lliira
9777552.blurb: Lliira is the goddess of Joy.

9495263.name: Lolth
9495263.blurb: Lolth was the Drow deity of conspiracies, deceit, and betrayal.

9461274.name: Maglubiyet
9461274.blurb: Maglubiyet is the ruler of the Goblinkin pantheon.

9762464.name: Malar
9762464.blurb: Malar is the chaotic evil true deity of predation.

9491037.name: Mask
9491037.blurb: Mask is the chaotic neutral, true spirit of thievery, heists, and illegal thrillseeking.

9792207.name: Memnor
9792207.blurb: Memnor is the Giant God of Pride and Control.

9564992.name: Mielikki
9564992.blurb: Mielikki is the chaotic good goddess of rangers, serene solitude, and finding oneself within nature.

9763003.name: Moander
9763003.blurb: Moander is the true spirit of the mortal fear of decay, rot, and the inevitability of biological destruction or death.

9495261.name: Myrkul
9495261.blurb: Myrkul is the god of deathly harvest and reaping.

9490015.name: Mystra
9490015.blurb: Mystra is the goddess of and physical manifestation of The Weave.

9709988.name: Obould
9709988.blurb: Obould Manyarrows was the founder of the Many Arrows Kingdom in the 15th century DR.

9901138.name: Obox-Ob
9901138.blurb: Obox-Ob is a former Demon Lord and the Obyrinth "Prince of Demons".

9491641.name: Oghma
9491641.blurb: Oghma is the True Spirit god of art, knowledge, and beauty.

9508824.name: Othea
9508824.blurb: Othea was the founder goddess of the Giants.

9997939.name: Savras
9997939.blurb: Savras is the god of foresight: particularly magical foresight.

9503876.name: Sekolah
9503876.blurb: Sekolah is the Sahuagin god of hunting and blood frenzy.

9490990.name: Shar
9490990.blurb: Shar, also the "Lady of Loss", is the greater Faerunian deity of loss, forgetfulness, and darkness.

9726626.name: Sharess
9726626.blurb: Sharess, known in Mulhorand as Bast, is the goddess of lust.

9832712.name: Shothotugg
9832712.blurb: Shothotugg, colloquially known as "The World Devourer", is an Eldritch Evil and ancient being of unknowable age, power, and size.

9494839.name: Silvanus
9494839.blurb: Silvanus, the Oakfather, is the true spirit of Survival.

9894600.name: Sseth
9894600.blurb: Sseth is the Yuan-Ti, Lizardfolk, and other serpentine Scalekin god of death, poison, and cunning.

9494835.name: Sune
9494835.blurb: Sune, also called Lady Firehair, is the goddess of connection.

9762466.name: Talona
9762466.blurb: Talona is the goddess of the scorn, especially in terms of relationships (but more literally in terms of poisons).

9489585.name: Talos
9489585.blurb: Talos, the Stormlord, is the chaotic evil god of natural destruction.

9495259.name: Tempus
9495259.blurb: Tempus is the true spirit god of war, combat, and battle fervor.

9904153.name: The Red Knight
9904153.blurb: The Red Knight is the aspect of warfare pertaining to battle tactics, campaign strategy, and war games.

9465748.name: Tiamat
9465748.blurb: Tiamat is the Draconic goddess of destruction, slavery, and cruelty.

9709628.name: Torm
9709628.blurb: Torm the True is the god of courage, duty, and sacrifice in the face of overwhelming odds.

9494838.name: Tymora
9494838.blurb: Tymora is the goddess of good luck and positive fate.

9489584.name: Umberlee
9489584.blurb: Umberlee, commonly known as "The Bitch Queen", is the chaotic evil god of oceanic destruction.

9710126.name: Waukeen
9710126.blurb: Waukeen is the goddess of Prosperity, merchants, salesmen, and the unending flow of goods and services between sapient beings.

9462587.name: Selune
9462587.blurb: Selune is the goddess of creation.
